title: imap/main: SQLite pool opened without create_if_missing
description: crates/imap/src/main.rs line 61 — SqlitePoolOptions::connect() is called with a plain sqlite: URL without SqliteConnectOptions::create_if_missing(true). If the database file does not yet exist, SQLite will return an error (SQLITE_CANTOPEN) rather than creating the file. The subsequent migrations will never run. The verify crate (crates/verify/src/lib.rs run_migrations) correctly uses create_if_missing. This inconsistency means a fresh stoa-imap deployment with no pre-existing database file will fail to start.
